description: This file contains functions for extracting and manipulating calibration data in a Linux-based system, particularly for embedded devices like OpenWrt. It includes functions for reading from different storage media, patching firmware with MAC addresses and checksums, and verifying data validity.

methods.name: caldata_dd
methods.description: Performs a 'dd' command with specified parameters to extract data from a source file or device.

methods.name: caldata_die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: caldata_extract
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a specified partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_ubi
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: caldata_extract_mmc
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_reverse
methods.description: Reverses byte order during data extraction before saving.

methods.name: caldata_from_file
methods.description: Copies calibration data from a source file to firmware location.

methods.name: caldata_sysfsload_from_file
methods.description: Loads calibration data into a sysfs attribute for device configuration.

methods.name: caldata_valid
methods.description: Checks if the firmware data has the expected magic number.

methods.name: caldata_patch_chksum
methods.description: Patches checksum and MAC address data within firmware.

methods.name: caldata_patch_mac
methods.description: Writes a MAC address into firmware and updates checksum.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address for ath9k devices.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac_crc
methods.description: Patches MAC address and CRC for ath9k devices.

methods.name: ath10k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address for ath10k devices.
